name: TB-500
summary: TB-500 is a synthetic N-acetylated heptapeptide (Ac-LKKTETQ) that matches residues 17-23 of human thymosin beta-4, the actin-binding domain. Esposito et al. identified that sequence in a product sold as TB-500 (PMID 22962027). It is not the full 43-amino-acid thymosin beta-4 protein. A synthetic LKKTETQ peptide promoted dermal wound repair in aged mice at a level comparable to the parent molecule (PMID 12581423). A review localises angiogenesis, wound healing, and cell-migration activity of thymosin beta-4 to this motif (PMID 20179146). SAHPRA names TB-500 among illegally marketed unregistered peptides. WADA prohibits thymosin-β4 and its derivatives, e.g. TB-500, at all times under S2.3.

research_uses.use: Dermal wound repair in aged mice using a synthetic LKKTETQ peptide matching the actin-binding domain of thymosin beta-4

sources.title: Thymosin beta 4 and a synthetic peptide containing its actin-binding domain promote dermal wound repair in db/db diabetic mice and in aged mice
sources.quote: The actin-binding domain of thymosin beta 4 duplicated in a seven-amino acid synthetic peptide, LKKTETQ, was able to promote repair in the aged animals comparable to that observed with the parent molecule.

research_uses.use: Angiogenesis, wound healing, and cell migration attributed to the LKKTETQ actin-binding motif of thymosin beta-4

sources.title: Biological activities of thymosin beta4 defined by active sites in short peptide sequences
sources.quote: a short sequence containing LKKTETQ, the central actin-binding domain (aa 17-23) plus 1 additional amino acid (Q), promotes angiogenesis, wound healing, and cell migration.

sahpra.notes: SAHPRA lists TB-500 among examples of illegally marketed unregistered peptides. This catalog entry is informational. It is not legal advice.

sources.title: SAHPRA peptide products public information
sources.quote: Illegally marketed peptides include: BPC-157, TB-500, Melanotan II, CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, PT-141, AOD-9604, Selank, and Semax.

wada.notes: The 2026 Prohibited List names Thymosin-β4 and its derivatives e.g. TB-500 under S2.3 Growth factors and growth factor modulators. Prohibited at all times (in- and out-of-competition).
